description: Fixed prompt suite for Phase 6 correctness baseline. Same prompts are replayed against the fallback backend (llama.cpp/SYCL) for the Phase 10 comparison.

chat.content: What is the capital of Australia? Answer in one sentence.
List exactly three benefits of unit testing, as a numbered list. Do not add any introduction or closing remarks.
Write a Python function `is_palindrome(s: str) -> bool` that ignores case and non-alphanumeric characters, plus two assertions. Output only code.
I want to store daily temperature readings. Which data structure should I use?
A list of dictionaries (or a dataclass list) works well when readings are appended in order; a dict keyed by date is better for random access by day.
Good. Now show me the dict-keyed version with a 3-line example and nothing else.

The following is a repetitive text block used to fill context. Read all of it, then answer the final question.

BLOCK_START
<REPEAT_ME>
BLOCK_END

Question: what was the very first word of the block? Reply with one word.

prompts.repeat_unit: alpha beta gamma delta epsilon zeta eta theta
